focus: Top-level driver phases, scanning architecture with feedback loops, data flow analysis, and user intervention surfaces in the Reko decompiler

pipeline.name: Load Binary / Project
pipeline.description: Loads or assembles a binary file or Reko project file (.rcproject). Determines loader by file extension or user override (User.Loader). Returns a structured Project with programs and metadata.
pipeline.inputs: File path, optional loader name, environment name, load address
pipeline.outputs: Project with loaded Program(s), platform metadata, segment map, image symbols, entry points

pipeline.name: Build Image Map
pipeline.description: Constructs an ImageMap from the Program's SegmentMap for later lookup of code vs data blocks during scanning.

pipeline.name: Extract Resources
pipeline.description: If User.ExtractResources is true, extracts embedded resources from programs to output directory.

pipeline.name: Scan Data Items
pipeline.description: Discovers global data (code pointers, strings, tables) by processing metadata globals, user-provided globals, platform memory map, and image symbols (Data type). Code pointers feed addresses into the Procedure discovery queue. Scans in WorkList style.
pipeline.outputs: ImageMap populated with global data items, sr.KnownProcedures updated with code pointer targets
substeps: Enqueue known data items to DataScanner
DataScanner.ProcessQueue() - value propagates through global data structures
Extract addresses referenced from code pointers

pipeline.name: Scan Procedures Recursively (Main Scanning Phase)
pipeline.description: Performs recursive descent disassembly from entry points and discovered code pointers. Uses a priority queue of WorkItems (ProcedureWorkItem, BlockWorkItem, ImageSymbolWorkItem, PromoteBlockWorkItem). Implements call/jump handling, procedure boundaries, thunk detection, and indirect dispatch.
pipeline.inputs: Program.User.Procedures, metadata.Procedures, Program.EntryPoints, Program.ImageSymbols (Procedure type), sr.KnownProcedures
pipeline.outputs: Program.Procedures populated with discovered Procedure objects, Program.ControlGraph with RtlBlocks, Program.CallGraph
substeps: Enqueue entry points and image symbols
- BlockWorker.ParseBlock() disassembles linear block, detects CTI (jump/call/return)
- Handle indirect dispatch: VectorBuilder + Backwalker for jump table recovery
- SplitBlock on jump targets in foreign procedures
- PromoteBlockWorkItem to merge blocks into new procedures

pipeline.name: Shingle Scan (Optional Heuristic)
pipeline.description: If User.Heuristics contains 'shingle', performs full-image pattern-based scanning to discover procedures not reachable by recursive descent. Uses ScannerInLinq (sliding window over gaps in ImageMap).
substeps: ScannerInLinq.ScanImage() scans gaps between known code blocks

pipeline.name: Analyze Data Flow
pipeline.description: Performs interprocedural SSA transformation and parameter/return value inference. Builds call graph, discovers which registers/memory locations are live-in/live-out, reconstructs procedure signatures from data flow.
pipeline.inputs: Program with all Procedures from scanning phase
pipeline.outputs: ProgramDataFlow with per-procedure ProcedureFlow (live registers, signatures), SSA-transformed Procedures, call graph edges
substeps: IntraBlockDeadRegisters.Apply() - eliminate dead registers within blocks
- Insert Phi functions at dominance frontiers
CallRewriter.Rewrite() - extract signatures and rewrite call sites

pipeline.name: Reconstruct Types
pipeline.description: Performs type inference on SSA values to infer structure, union, and array types. Builds equivalence classes of storage locations with identical type constraints.
pipeline.outputs: Program.TypeStore populated with inferred DataTypes, Procedures rewritten with typed expressions
substeps: ExpressionNormalizer.Transform() - normalize expressions to canonical form
EquivalenceClassBuilder.Build() - unify storage equivalence classes by constraints
TypeCollector.CollectTypes() - gather all type information from code
PtrPrimitiveReplacer.ReplaceAll() - distinguish primitive pointers from typed
TypedExpressionRewriter.RewriteProgram() - update AST with inferred types

pipeline.name: Structure Program
pipeline.description: Converts unstructured CFG with gotos into high-level structured code (if/while/for/switch). Per-procedure region graph analysis and pattern matching.
pipeline.inputs: Procedures with typed blocks and expressions

pipeline.name: Write Decompiled Products
pipeline.description: Outputs decompiled code (high-level language), type declarations, intermediate representations, and disassembly.
pipeline.inputs: Structured Procedures with typed AST, TypeStore, Program metadata

feedback_loops.name: VectorBuilder + Backwalker feedback during scanning
feedback_loops.trigger: BlockWorker encounters an indirect jump (RtlGoto/RtlSwitch with memory/register operand) requiring jump table resolution
feedback_loops.rewinds_to: ProcessQueue() in Scanner - new addresses from jump table targets are enqueued as BlockWorkItems
feedback_loops.mechanism: VectorBuilder.Build() backwalks instructions to find comparison bounds, Backwalker derives stride/table address, BuildTable() extracts addresses, EnqueueJumpTarget() re-enqueues at PriorityJumpTarget

feedback_loops.name: Data pointers discovery → procedure enqueue during scanning
feedback_loops.trigger: DataScanner processes global data and extracts code pointer addresses
feedback_loops.rewinds_to: ScanProceduresRecursively(), ProcessQueue() - extracted addresses enqueued as ImageSymbolWorkItem
feedback_loops.mechanism: ScanDataItems() calls dataScanner.ProcessQueue(), which identifies code pointers in data; EnqueueImageSymbol() adds to procQueue

feedback_loops.name: Block splitting on jump target conflicts in scanning
feedback_loops.trigger: EnqueueJumpTarget discovers a jump to middle of existing block in foreign procedure
feedback_loops.rewinds_to: ProcessQueue() - SplitBlock creates new block at target, potentially PromoteBlockWorkItem queued
feedback_loops.mechanism: SplitBlock() terminates old block, creates new block at target address, possibly creates thunk and enqueues PromoteBlockWorkItem with priority PriorityBlockPromote (3)

feedback_loops.name: SSA transformation → Call signature discovery → re-analysis in DataFlow
feedback_loops.trigger: SsaTransform builds per-procedure SSA; UnusedOutValuesRemover identifies live-out registers at call sites
feedback_loops.rewinds_to: CallRewriter.Rewrite() uses live-in/live-out sets to extract function signatures, which may differ from initial scanner assumptions
feedback_loops.mechanism: DataFlowAnalysis.UntangleProcedures() runs SSA per SCC, then CallRewriter.EnsureSignature() updates proc.Signature and ProgramDataFlow[proc].Signature; subsequent call sites use refined signatures

feedback_loops.name: Type inference constraint propagation feedback
feedback_loops.trigger: TypeCollector gathers type constraints; EquivalenceClassBuilder unifies equivalence classes
feedback_loops.rewinds_to: TypeVariableReplacer re-processes and solves constraints iteratively (implicit fixed-point loop in EquivalenceClassBuilder.Build())
feedback_loops.mechanism: EquivalenceClassBuilder.Build() rebuilds equivalence classes as constraints are gathered, potentially merging classes multiple times until fixpoint

feedback_loops.name: Structure analysis → region refinement iteration
feedback_loops.trigger: StructureAnalysis.Execute() in post-order traversal: region cannot match any schema, or cyclic region cannot be reduced
feedback_loops.rewinds_to: Same iteration step: RegionFactory.Refine() or last-resort refinement re-structures the region graph, re-queues regions for processing
feedback_loops.mechanism: Do-while loop in StructureAnalysis.Execute() (line ~143-175): if regions changed in iteration, loop continues; if stuck, applies last-resort refinement (line ~3.7)

feedback_loops.name: User annotation → scanner re-enqueue (OnLoadedScript feedback)
feedback_loops.trigger: Reko scripts executed via Project.FireScriptEvent(ScriptEvent.OnProgramLoaded) can modify Program.User.Procedures, Program.User.Globals
feedback_loops.rewinds_to: ScanProgram() checks program.NeedsScanning; if true, creates scanner; if User.Procedures changed by script, new EnqueueUserProcedure() calls insert into procQueue
feedback_loops.mechanism: Script can add/remove User.Procedures entries; ScanProceduresRecursively() iterates User.Procedures and enqueues

feedback_loops.name: Scanning boundary edits during block promotion
feedback_loops.trigger: PromoteBlockWorkItem detects a block needs promotion to its own procedure (mid-procedure jump target with complex CFG)
feedback_loops.rewinds_to: ProcessQueue() - block is removed from old procedure, added to new procedure; ProcedureWorkItem enqueued for new entry
feedback_loops.mechanism: blocks BTreeDictionary is mutated (blocks.Remove, blocks.Add); proc.ControlGraph.Blocks updated; new ProcedureWorkItem enqueued

decision_points.name: Loader selection at Load stage
decision_points.decision: Which IImageLoader plugin to use. Determined by file extension or User.Loader string override. Default: binary format detection.
decision_points.alternatives: Different loader (e.g. ELF, PE, Mach-O, raw binary) produces different SegmentMap and symbol table; affects all downstream code/data discovery.
decision_points.current_override: User.Loader property or file extension heuristic

decision_points.name: Platform / environment selection
decision_points.decision: Which IPlatform to use (x86, ARM, MIPS, etc.). Determined from binary metadata or User.Environment override.
decision_points.alternatives: Different platform → different architecture rewriter, register definitions, calling conventions, memory layout → all analysis downstream changes

decision_points.name: Heuristic scanning trigger (shingle scan)
decision_points.decision: Whether to perform shingle-based heuristic scanning for unreachable code. Controlled by User.Heuristics.Contains('shingle').
decision_points.alternatives: No shingle scan → procedures in dead code, trampolines, overlaid code not discovered; with shingle → more false positives but better coverage

decision_points.name: Call ABI heuristic during SSA (isTrashed callback)
decision_points.decision: Whether calls respect ABI (preserve non-trashed registers) or conservatively assume all registers trashed. Set by User.Heuristics.Contains(AnalysisHeuristics.CallsRespectABI).
decision_points.alternatives: Different assumption → different liveness sets → different signature inference

decision_points.name: Procedure boundary splitting heuristic
decision_points.decision: When a jump lands mid-block in a foreign procedure: clone block or promote to new procedure? Decision via IsBlockLinearProcedureExit().
decision_points.alternatives: Clone → single procedure spans original block; promote → new procedure → more procedures but cleaner
decision_points.current_override: Hardcoded heuristic: if block ends with return, clone; else promote

decision_points.name: SSA phi insertion algorithm variant
decision_points.decision: SSA form computation method. Uses Braun-Buchwald-Hack algorithm without explicit dominator tree calculation.
decision_points.alternatives: Different SSA algorithm (e.g., Cytron) → same result, different performance characteristics

decision_points.name: Loop detection vs multi-exit region in structure analysis
decision_points.decision: Whether a cyclic region is a loop or an unstructured multi-way exit. Determined by schema matching order and last-resort refinement.
decision_points.alternatives: Different decision → different high-level construct (while/for vs goto-heavy code)
decision_points.current_override: Schema matching order; iteration depth limit ~1000 triggers last-resort

decision_points.name: NoDecompile procedure filtering
decision_points.decision: Whether to process a procedure marked with User.Procedures[addr].Decompile=false. If false, create stub only.
decision_points.alternatives: Skip → no analysis; create stub → call site can match signature

decision_points.name: User-provided signature override
decision_points.where: Scan Procedures Recursively & Analyze Data Flow
decision_points.decision: If User.Procedures[addr].Signature or User.Procedures[addr].CSignature provided, use it instead of inferring.
decision_points.alternatives: Use provided sig → inferred from dataflow is skipped; infer → ignore user input

decision_points.name: Register value assumption (SetAssumedRegisterValues)
decision_points.decision: If User.Procedures[addr].Assume provided, set ProcessorState register values. Affects value propagation during block parsing.
decision_points.alternatives: Use assumed values → affects constant propagation; ignore → different dataflow values

intervention_surfaces.name: User.Procedures map
intervention_surfaces.description: Per-address procedure metadata: name, signature, C signature, output file, ordinal, assume register values, decompile flag, characteristics
intervention_surfaces.affects: Scanner (procedure discovery priority, initial signature), DataFlow (signature override), all downstream phases

intervention_surfaces.name: User.Globals map
intervention_surfaces.description: Per-address global variable metadata: name, type (SerializedType), optional comment
intervention_surfaces.affects: Scanner.ScanDataItems() (data discovery), Type reconstruction (types are applied directly)

intervention_surfaces.name: User.Heuristics set
intervention_surfaces.description: Scanning heuristics: 'shingle' (gap scanning), 'CallsRespectABI' (call signature inference mode)
intervention_surfaces.affects: Scanner.ShingleScanProcedures() gate, SsaTransform constructor (isTrashed callback)

intervention_surfaces.name: User.IndirectJumps map
intervention_surfaces.description: Per-address indirect jump metadata: table address, table size, stride (optional)
intervention_surfaces.affects: Scanner during jump table recovery (VectorBuilder.Build() can be seeded/overridden)

intervention_surfaces.name: User.JumpTables map
intervention_surfaces.description: Explicit jump table definitions: per-address ImageMapVectorTable with entry size and targets
intervention_surfaces.affects: Scanner (overrides VectorBuilder result or provides pre-computed tables)

intervention_surfaces.name: User.Loader override
intervention_surfaces.description: Explicitly specifies which IImageLoader plugin to use (e.g. 'ElfLoader', 'PeLoader')
intervention_surfaces.affects: Load stage (loader plugin selection)

intervention_surfaces.name: User.Processor override
intervention_surfaces.description: Architecture moniker (e.g. 'x86-32', 'arm', 'mips32'), overrides binary header
intervention_surfaces.affects: Load stage (architecture initialization), all subsequent disassembly and analysis

intervention_surfaces.name: User.Environment override
intervention_surfaces.description: Platform name (e.g. 'win32', 'linux', 'bare-metal'), overrides binary metadata
intervention_surfaces.affects: Load stage (platform selection), calling conventions, ABI rules, metadata loading

intervention_surfaces.name: User.LoadAddress override
intervention_surfaces.description: Load address for raw binaries (when binary format has no embedded address)
intervention_surfaces.affects: Load stage (memory layout), all address calculations downstream

intervention_surfaces.name: User.Calls map
intervention_surfaces.description: Per-address call site metadata: user-specified signature, register values, characteristics
intervention_surfaces.affects: DataFlow (may override inferred signatures at call sites) - currently marked $REVIEW as unused

intervention_surfaces.name: User.Annotations list
intervention_surfaces.description: Per-address code/data comments, injected into disassembly output
intervention_surfaces.affects: Scanner (CommentInjector), disassembly writer

intervention_surfaces.name: User.Segments list
intervention_surfaces.description: User-defined segments with custom addresses/sizes/access modes (code/data executable flags)
intervention_surfaces.affects: Load stage (segment map override), scanning (executable bit controls entry point marking)

intervention_surfaces.name: User.Patches map
intervention_surfaces.description: Per-address code patches: RtlStatement replacements for corrupted/unknown instructions
intervention_surfaces.affects: Scanner BlockWorker (patches applied during instruction fetching)

intervention_surfaces.name: User.RegisterValues map
intervention_surfaces.description: Per-address assumed register values (e.g. global base register)
intervention_surfaces.affects: Scanner (ProcessorState initialization), value propagation during block parsing

intervention_surfaces.name: User.OnLoadedScript
intervention_surfaces.description: Script_v2 executed after image load, before scanning. Can modify User.Procedures, User.Globals, etc.
intervention_surfaces.affects: All phases via mutations to User data structures

intervention_surfaces.name: User.OutputFilePolicy
intervention_surfaces.description: Policy for output file organization: 'SegmentPolicy', 'ProcedurePolicy', etc.
intervention_surfaces.affects: WriteDecompilerProducts() (output file generation)

intervention_surfaces.name: User.ExtractResources
intervention_surfaces.description: If true, extract embedded resources to output directory
intervention_surfaces.affects: ExtractResources() phase

intervention_surfaces.name: User.ProcedureSourceFiles map
intervention_surfaces.description: Per-address output file assignment (write procedure to specific source file)
intervention_surfaces.affects: WriteDecompilerProducts() output file routing

intervention_surfaces.name: MetadataFile entries in Project
intervention_surfaces.description: User-provided external type library/signature files (.lib, .h, .sig)
intervention_surfaces.affects: Load stage (metadata loaded into TypeLibrary), all type-based analysis

intervention_surfaces.name: Script event hooks (OnProgramLoaded, OnProgramScanned, OnProgramDecompiled)
intervention_surfaces.description: Scripts fired at phase transitions; can inspect/modify program state
intervention_surfaces.affects: All phases via script callbacks

intervention_surfaces.name: Procedure.Characteristics
intervention_surfaces.description: Per-procedure properties: pure, allocator, noreturn, etc., affects call/dataflow handling
intervention_surfaces.affects: DataFlow (CallRewriter considers characteristics), Scanner (noreturn procs don't enqueue fallthrough)

insights: Reko's phases are NOT strictly sequential: Scanning/DataFlow boundary is permeable. VectorBuilder + Backwalker (backtracking value propagation during scanning) prefigure SSA dataflow analysis. This 'two-phase scan then analyze' model masks implicit interprocedural feedback.

Priority queue in Scanner (PriorityEntryPoint=5, PriorityJumpTarget=6, PriorityGlobalData=7, PriorityVector=4, PriorityBlockPromote=3) encodes a soft ordering that adapts to feedback: jump table discovery re-enqueues addresses at different priority.

User intervention is granular (per-address annotations, procedures, globals) rather than global flags. This enables surgical overrides without full re-run, but requires careful replay of dependent phases.

Feedback loop mechanisms are scattered (VectorBuilder feed-forward, Block splitting mid-scan, SSA signature discovery, type constraint propagation). There's no unified 'fixpoint iteration' framework; each loop is ad-hoc.

The Scanning phase internally implements a worklist (procQueue) with priorities, not unlike a decompiler frontend. Block splitting and procedure promotion are late-binding decisions that mutate the procedure graph mid-scan.

Type reconstruction is surprisingly decoupled from scanning/dataflow: TypeAnalyzer reads SSA-transformed procedures and outputs typed AST, but doesn't feed back. User types (User.Globals) are applied directly without constraint propagation.

Structure analysis uses region graphs (not CFG), then pattern-matches against schemas. Unmatched regions trigger refinement (loop insertion, switch promotion). The 1000-iteration limit is a last-resort termination gate, not a convergence criterion.
Reko has two scanner implementations (Scanner vs Scanner2, gated by #if NEW_SCANNER). The code analysis here covers Scanner; Scanner2 (newer, incomplete) is an alternate architecture.
User-provided signatures in User.Procedures are injected early (ScanProceduresRecursively), overriding inference. Dataflow-inferred signatures (CallRewriter) augment but don't override user sigs.
The ImageMap is a key shared data structure: tracks both code blocks and data ranges. Overlaps between code and data are resolved by conflict detection (BlockConflictResolver) during scanning.
